title: Peterborough City Hall anti-lockdown rally
notes: Global News page description dates this executed rally to March 13, 2021, outside the February unit. No February participation or continuity is established.

title: Hamilton Hugs Over Masks rally outside City Hall
notes: Global News reports police said only four attended the Feb. 7 rally and that organizers did not come. Three people later faced charges/tickets; the report does not establish arrests at the event. Jan. 17 attendance and charges are a separate gathering and are not carried forward.

title: Hamilton Hugs Over Masks rally at City Hall forecourt
notes: CHCH dates the reported Sunday gathering to the weekend before its Jan. 18 article; a second Jan. 18 story gives 20–25 attendees, 16 tickets issued to 13 people. This is a January event and does not establish attendance or continuity in February.

title: Daily Indian-farmer-solidarity demonstrations outside the Indian High Commission in Ottawa
notes: CIVICUS reports daily actions outside the Indian High Commission during February and March in solidarity with Indian farmers; the quoted aim was repeal of India’s farm laws. The codebook excludes protests in Canada targeted at another country’s policies. The source gives no specific February daily turnout or boundaries; do not import participant totals from Victoria or count each day as a separate event without source evidence.
